scope: Scientific reading recorded after all28 model proposals and before formal confirmation. The final two method evaluations may still be running. Final prediction quality is reported separately in summary.json; these judgments are not fed back to research models.

observed_research_capabilities.example: Opus-A round3 recovered elemental property values from stoichiometric fractions and weighted-mean descriptor columns, then constructed weighted quantiles, skew and composition-shape features in a free program.
observed_research_capabilities.meaning: An actual proposed and executed representation beyond a fixed estimator menu. Development component checks support a conditional contribution; literature novelty and physical causal validity are not established.

observed_research_capabilities.example: Fable-B round5 distinguished label-conditional bias from prediction-conditional calibration. Its computed curve was near identity and external isotonic calibration failed to improve development RMSE; round6 explicitly changed direction to representation.
observed_research_capabilities.meaning: Computed observations changed the next research question. The claimed internal nested calibration estimate has a dependency flaw, retained below.

observed_research_capabilities.example: Opus-B's group-pooling/decomposition method regressed on development (13.3976 versus earlier12.4950), and subsequent proposals explicitly treated it as a transfer counterexample before testing other explanations.
observed_research_capabilities.meaning: Negative results were used in subsequent choices rather than silently removed. This rules against the tested method, not every hierarchical model.

observed_research_capabilities.example: Both A trajectories repaired a rejected analysis and called the rejection operational rather than a negative scientific measurement. Fable-B later corrected how it unwrapped historical prediction artifacts.
observed_research_capabilities.meaning: Some recovery and evidence-use ability, alongside repeated failures.

component_evidence.designed_by: operator, after observing development success and before confirmation; not counted as agent-designed research
component_evidence.interpretation: At fixed learner specifications, folds and blend-fitting procedure, retaining all new features improves this selected development result by0.269827K. The contribution is conditional on this pipeline and selected dataset. Most improvement over the simple reference still cannot be assigned solely to the new representation. No component-confirmation measurements were requested.

critical_errors_and_limits.examples: Opus-B round2 says parent representation is identical but changes204 to215 input columns and family definitions. Fable-A round6 says it only appends target encodings but drops the parent's81 X columns (167 to100 columns) and changes resampling details. Opus-A round7 describes the round3 five-learner, composition-plus-property ensemble as one GBM on81 descriptors.
critical_errors_and_limits.consequence: A plausible research narrative can silently change the experimental control. Source fidelity needs direct checking and exact program reuse.

critical_errors_and_limits.issue: Computed quantities do not validate their scientific names
critical_errors_and_limits.examples: Repeated or rounded-composition residuals and leave-one-out errors are repeatedly called an irreducible noise floor. They describe an observed selected subset with missing conditions, not a population lower bound. A failed MLP is described as confirming all axis-aligned-tree alternatives.
critical_errors_and_limits.consequence: Calculation helps reasoning but does not automatically calibrate its interpretation.

critical_errors_and_limits.examples: Fable-B round5 and Opus-B round5 fit second-level calibrators on rotated base-model OOF predictions, whose other-fold values were produced using held-fold labels upstream. This is not fully nested validation. Fable-B round6 and Opus-A round6 correctly recompute target encodings inside each outer training split.
critical_errors_and_limits.consequence: Keep the internal-estimate flaw separate from the externally isolated development and confirmation measurements.

critical_errors_and_limits.issue: Diagnostic information computed but unavailable for the next choice
critical_errors_and_limits.examples: Opus-A rounds5/6 condition their expected decision on NNLS weights or internal rankings but return only predictions. The B contract permits those quantities as optional findings in the same fit; it does not guarantee correct use or a quality gain.
critical_errors_and_limits.consequence: Returning compact fitted diagnostics removes a real information-loss point without a mandatory extra phase.

critical_errors_and_limits.issue: Application friction and incomplete failure recall
critical_errors_and_limits.examples: Five actions were rejected for json/collections imports under the declared narrow policy; Opus-A repeats an earlier json failure. Several method programs catch broad internal errors without reporting them.
critical_errors_and_limits.consequence: All observable rejected actions remain. Benign-library restrictions and missing schema/history details waste research effort; a valid final prediction does not expose every hidden constituent failure.

critical_errors_and_limits.examples: One A/B pair per model on one familiar public dataset; grouping removes exact element-set overlap but not common elements/families. Source paper random-split RMSE is not comparable. Manual source review and synchronization enter elapsed time. No result proves new superconductors, a physical law, literature novelty, or stable general research benefit.
critical_errors_and_limits.consequence: Report the whole four-project denominator and final transfer scores. Do not equate a score improvement, more findings, or fewer calls with researcher-level capability.

implementation: One optional fitted-method findings return in the small application example, with external scoring and evaluation labels excluded. Existing analysis and normal native CPU/research interfaces are reused; no new mandatory reflection or memory phase.
next_priority: Make the exact measured parent program and its input/output schema readily usable in the next research step; test whether this reduces false single-component claims and repeated experimental mistakes on a fresh problem. Simplify benign source restrictions within that fresh frozen experiment, rather than adding more forced stages or tuning revealed confirmation rows.
